securityBoundary.signing: Users independently review and authorize transactions inside Xaman. XRBitcoinCash cannot sign for users or recover wallet credentials.
securityBoundary.secretHandling: Official interfaces must never request or store seed phrases, recovery phrases, private keys, wallet secrets, passcodes, secret numbers, or remote-access credentials.
securityBoundary.transactionIntent: Before signing, independently verify transaction type, account, destination, issuer, currency, amount, fee, flags, and memo fields inside Xaman.
securityBoundary.authoritativeData: Validated XRP Ledger data is authoritative. Browser summaries, scores, screenshots, and exports are decision-support evidence only.
securityBoundary.successRule: A signed or submitted payload is not final success. Confirm the expected transaction hash, validated true, tesSUCCESS, and all material transaction fields against authoritative XRP Ledger data.
